summary: Iteration 29: Frontend-only review of (1) splash screen, (2) skeleton loaders and (3) PL/UA i18n toggle. All critical flows pass. Splash hides correctly after React mount. ForemanEntry shows LanguageToggle; clicking 'UA' translates Logowanie brygadzisty -> Вхід для бригадира, Zaloguj -> Увійти, Imie -> Ім'я, Haslo -> Пароль. Choice persists in localStorage('fegrro_lang'='uk') across reload. Clicking 'PL' reverts. No toggle on /login or /admin/dashboard (admin login still works -> no regression from LanguageProvider). EquipmentAdmin shows skeleton-table during initial fetch when admin opens Elektronarzedzia tab. Backend smoke OK: /api/auth/admin/login=200, /api/equipment=200.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: GET / redirects to /foreman (Home = <Navigate to='/foreman'/>), so '/' DOES show the language toggle. The review_request listed '/' under 'admin pages with NO toggle'. This is a documentation/intent mismatch, not a bug - '/' is functionally the foreman entry. If the intent was to make '/' the admin landing, the redirect target should change.

STRINGS dict at /app/frontend/src/i18n/strings.js mixes Polish ASCII (Imie, Haslo, Sprzet) without diacritics in some keys while the UI elsewhere uses full diacritics. Consider unifying for consistency in PL spelling.

Splash recovery relies on MutationObserver + 8s fallback - works correctly in tests but if React error boundary fires before first child mount the splash will stay until 8s. Could add a window error listener to force hide on uncaught render errors.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on assertions executed (PublicHours/WorkerDashboard live UI skipped - empty employees collection / no approved foreman in DB; code paths verified by grep)

context_for_next_testing_agent: DB currently has 0 employees so /hours/{token} cannot be exercised live. WorkerDashboard live UI also needs an approved foreman. To test PublicHours/WorkerDashboard end-to-end with i18n+skeleton, seed at least one employee with public_token and one approved foreman. All i18n+skeleton code paths are wired (grep-verified) but only ForemanEntry login screen + AdminDashboard + EquipmentAdmin tabs were UI-verified.
